April 21, 2018 - By Michael Collier 
P Schoenfeld Asset Management Lp increased its stake in Firstenergy Corp (FE) by 78.57% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. P Schoenfeld Asset Management Lp bought 275,000 shares as the company’s stock rose 13.29% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund held 625,000 shares of the central company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $19.14M, up from 350,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. P Schoenfeld Asset Management Lp who had been investing in Firstenergy Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $16.42B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.23% or $0.43 during the last trading session, reaching $34.44. About 4.23 million shares traded. FirstEnergy Corp. (NYSE:FE) has risen 10.00% since April 21, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 1.55% the S&P500.
